basic.name: Ravage
basic.description:
Leap to a target, dealing 115~~0.04~~ damage. If the enemy dies within 0.75 seconds, restore 1 charge and refund 20 Mana.

Quest: Kill enemies within a short distance of Kerrigan. Minions grant 1 stack and Heroes grant 7 stacks. 

Reward: After reaching 100 stacks, Ravage deals 125 additional damage and Hero kills now provide 14 stacks.

Mythic Reward: After reaching a 250 stacks, Ravage deals a further 200 additional damage.

basic.name: Impaling Blades
basic.description: After 1.25 seconds, deal 150~~0.04~~ damage to enemies within the target area, Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

basic.name: Primal Grasp
basic.description: Pulls enemies within the target area towards Kerrigan, dealing 40~~0.04~~ damage. After 2.5 seconds, an explosion occurs around Kerrigan, dealing 160~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies.

heroic.name: Summon Ultralisk
heroic.description:
After 0.5 seconds, summon an Ultralisk that rushes forward upon spawning, dealing 225~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

The Ultralisk's Basic Attacks deal 50% of their damage in an area around their target. Reactivate to retarget the Ultralisk.

heroic.name: Maelstrom
heroic.description: Deals 74~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.

heroic.name: Command Ultralisk
heroic.description: Order the Ultralisk to attack an enemy or move to an area.

trait.name: Assimilation
trait.description:
Gain 10% of damage dealt from Abilities and 20% from Basic Attacks as Shields for 6 seconds. Shield amount gained doubled against Heroes.

Current maximum: 1004~~0.04~~

activable.name: Chrysalis
activable.description:
Activate to place Kerrigan in a Chrysalis with 650~~0.04~~ Health for 5 seconds. While inside, Kerrigan regenerates 4% of her maximum Health per second.

Enemies can destroy the Chrysalis to end its effects early.

activable.name: Psionic Shift
activable.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location, dealing 50~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies. Generates 300% increased Assimilation Shields from the damage dealt.

level1.name: Siphoning Impact
level1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Ravage grants 100~~0.04~~ points of Assimilation Shields.

level1.name: Assimilation Mastery
level1.description: Regeneration Globe healing grants 50~~0.04~~ points of Assimilation Shields per second while active. While Assimilation is active, Kerrigan's Health and Mana regeneration is increased by 150%.

level1.name: Fury of the Swarm
level1.description: After casting Ravage, Kerrigan's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds splashes for 100% damage around the target.

level4.name: Ravaging Ferocity
level4.description: Ravage grants Kerrigan 25% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

level4.name: Kinetic Fulmination
level4.description: Damaging an enemy increases the damage of Kerrigan's next Impaling Blades within 10 seconds by 10%, up to 100%.

level4.name: Psionic Pulse
level4.description: Primal Grasp explodes a second time 2 seconds after its first explosion.

level7.name: Queen of Blades
level7.description: Reduce the cooldown of Ravage by 4 seconds and increase its damage to Minions and Mercenaries by 100%.

level7.name: Boundless Fury
level7.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Ravage grants a charge of Ravage. Can only occur once every 12 seconds per Hero.

level7.name: Bladed Momentum
level7.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Kerrigan's Basic Abilities by 0.75 seconds.

level13.name: Psionic Barrier
level13.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Primal Grasp grants 20 Spell Armor and 4% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20% Movement Speed.

level13.name: Volatile Power
level13.description: Increase the amount of Assimilation Shields granted from damage dealt by 10%, but reduce duration of Assimilation by 3 seconds.

Enemies can destroy the Chrysalis to end its effects early.

level16.name: Mounting Potency
level16.description: Ravage grants 5% Spell Power for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

level16.name: Painful Spikes
level16.description: Enemies hit by Impaling Blades take an additional 60~~0.04~~ damage the next 6 times Kerrigan damages them within 5 seconds.

level16.name: Unbridled Energy
level16.description: Damaging a Hero with a Heroic Ability grants 35% Spell Power for 4 seconds.

level20.name: Omegastorm
level20.description: Maelstrom's duration is increased by 0.4 seconds every time it damages a Hero.

level20.name: Torrasque
level20.description: Increase the Health and Basic Attack damage of the Ultralisk by 20%. The Ultralisk morphs into an egg when it dies. If the egg isn't killed within 4 seconds, a new Ultralisk is born.

level20.name: Assimilation Blades
level20.description: Damaging an enemy increases Basic Attack damage by 2% for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

level20.name: Psionic Shift
level20.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location, dealing 50~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies. Generates 300% increased Assimilation Shields from the damage dealt.
